generator: ChatGPT image generation (project owner, paid plan)
prompts: Based on scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-rigs/paratrooper.json. One conversation drew the master; the damage sheet, the attack strip, the hit strip and the defeat strip were each drawn from the master as one prompt per image, all on flat magenta. Red appears only on the armband and the harness patch so the team tint lands only there; the camouflage smock, helmet netting and gear are olive, brown and tan. The attack, hit and defeat prompts keep the carbine in his hands in every frame, ask for a pale yellow (never red or orange) muzzle flash and ask for no blood, glow or halo. The prompts ChatGPT actually ran were written for this unit and were not captured verbatim.
